scope: Four matched original tasks across four additional requested models, one first-pass run each.
selection_timing: Supplemental plan fixed before extra-model calls, after primary outputs had become visible. This is not a preregistration made before all project outcomes.
selection_rationale: Selection uses the audited occupation and native-file requirements: three occupations, spreadsheet calculation, spreadsheet template preservation, a presentation, and a PDF form plus Word assessment. No task prompt or source is replaced.

tasks.name: GMP endotoxin discrepancy and change request
tasks.selection_feature: Source PDF form completion and separate risk assessment

tasks.name: BridgeMind October 2025 monthly report
tasks.selection_feature: Nine-slide presentation using multiple native sources

tasks.name: Daily shipping manifest
tasks.selection_feature: Preserve and complete the original workbook template

first_pass.order: Task order above, then model order above

optional_second_pass.gate: All 16 first-pass cells have physical attempts and terminal records; primary and first-pass grading attempts are recorded; bounded judge checks are completed or explicitly funded; a separate release file records remaining grading/check/contingency reserves, and the rough second-pass forecast fits the remaining amended ceiling.

primary_gate: All 15 original GPT-6.1 Sol primary slots have terminal results with at least one physical solver request. Primary grading attempts must also be recorded before extra models, retaining invalid grades and no-submission records honestly; hash-verified grader continuations may satisfy this gate. The separate Sol shipping adapter-repair cohort must submit before extra models.
shipping_compatibility_amendment: Use config/evaluation_v2_shipping_compatibility.json for every additional model on the shipping task. Private import copies normalize only Content_Types XML namespace serialization, with original source hashes retained and semantic/ZIP-member invariance checks. All other selected tasks use the frozen engine unchanged. The repaired Sol shipping output is a separate cohort, not a replacement primary result.

budget.wallet_cash_and_key_allowance: Root verifies both before each paid phase; account cash is not inferred from the key allowance.
budget.estimate: Measured completed GPT-6.1 Sol task costs scaled by the larger input/output catalog price ratio, with a 1x–2x planning range. Missing completed-task baselines use the largest available matched completed-task cost and are explicitly marked imputed. This is a rough forecast, not a bound or guarantee.

execution.client: Shared amended_client ledger with an extension-only image reservation subclass
execution.remaining_cells: Keep every planned cell visible with its actual status or not_started; no silent task/model replacement.

grading.judge: Frozen primary judge and rubric; use grade_evaluation_v2.run_primary with the matching stage
grading.repeat_two_cli_note: The existing grader function accepts supplemental_r2 even though its CLI choices do not; use a separate dispatcher or direct function call without editing frozen files.
grading.human_acceptance: Unmeasured until new human labels are collected.

claims: Four tasks do not replace the original 15-task primary slice
Catalog availability is not proof of successful solver runtime access
Later repeats are supplemental and depend on budget
